titulo: Can Iran really launch sea mines from rockets? | About That
cuerpo: U.S. Central Command says it carried out fresh strikes on Iran, claiming it was retaliation for Iran preparing to launch sea mines from rockets into the Strait of Hormuz. Andrew Chang digs deeper into what may be Iran's novel ability to deploy underwater mines with missiles. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, CAT-UXO, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
